summary.core_problem: 系统分析表示深度、探针表达能力、稀疏特征、谎言类型等因素对LLM欺骗检测探针效果的影响
summary.importance: 补充了覆盖编造、遗漏、夸张三类谎言的欺骗检测数据集，给出了探针设计选择的实证参考结论
summary.technical_approach: 扩充包含多类型欺骗的标注数据集，测试7种不同探针在不同网络层、稠密/SAE稀疏特征下的跨类型检测表现
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖7类探针，发现最优探针深度高度依赖数据集，高表达能力探针仅在特定场景优于线性基线，稀疏自编码器特征与稠密隐态的检测效果相当

summary_en.core_problem: Systematically study how representation depth, probe expressivity, sparse features, and lie typology impact LLM deception detection probe performance
summary_en.importance: Augments standard deception detection datasets with fabrication, omission, and exaggeration examples, provides empirical guidance for probe design choices
summary_en.technical_approach: Build an augmented multi-type deception dataset, test 7 probe types across network layers, comparing dense hidden states and sparse autoencoder features for cross-type deception detection
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 probe types, results show optimal representation depth is highly dataset-dependent, more expressive probes provide only selective gains over linear baselines, and sparse autoencoder features perform similarly to dense hidden states

recommendation.zh: 特定欺骗检测任务下的探针消融，结论对通用表示探测参考有限，看摘要结论即可
recommendation.en: Probe ablation on the narrow deception detection task, limited generalizability to general representation analysis, read abstract conclusions only

paper.title: Latent Communication Between Language Model Agents: Channels, Alignment, and the Limits of Text
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are utilized in many contexts and many professions. Those MAS rely on inter-agent communication, usually implemented by clear-text message passing. We hypothesize that Large Language Models may have a world model at their disposal that exceeds expressibility in text when complex concepts need to be communicated. Our aim is to approach a proof of this hypothesis with structured experiments. In this work, we show that LLM agents communicating via text lose information, wh

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：LLM agent 之间只用自然语言或 JSON 传递信息，是否会因为把高维内部表征压缩成文本而丢失对任务有用的信息。作者把这个问题拆成两个层面：表征层面是否有信息损失，以及这些损失是否会转化为任务性能差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对多 agent 通信、表征对齐和 SAE 分析有一定启发。它给了一个比较克制的负结果：不同模型的中后层表征可以被几何对齐，文本序列化也确实会丢掉大量 SAE feature，但这些被丢掉的 feature 主要像是表面形式信息，而不是当前任务需要的语义信息。因此，至少在作者构造的概念识别任务里，直接 latent 通信没有超过文本通信。这一点对“绕过文本瓶颈”的研究有校准作用。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较三种 agent 间通信通道：第一是 dense latent，直接传递发送模型的完整 hidden state；第二是 SAE-sparse，把 hidden state 通过预训练 sparse autoencoder 压成稀疏 feature；第三是普通文本通信。发送端使用 Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct，接收端使用 Mistral 7B base 或 instruction-tuned 版本。激活取中后层 residual stream 的 last-token hidden state，Llama 取第 23 层，Mistral 取第 24 层，维度都是 4096。跨模型 latent 通信用 Procrustes alignment 做线性正交对齐，目的是测试不同架构是否存在可对齐的概念几何。SAE feature 分析用于判断文本序列化前后哪些 feature 被保留、哪些被破坏。方法上的关键点不是提出新的训练算法，而是把“文本是否是 lossy channel”这个问题做成了可测量的通道保真度实验。
summary.experiments: 概念数据集包含 84 组人工构造的 concept pair，覆盖 factual、abstract、overlap、context-dependent 等类别，每个概念配多个 cloze-style prompt。论文先做两个 gate：概念在发送模型激活空间中是否线性可分，SAE feature 空间是否能反映语义相似性。主要结果有三点。第一，Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct 和 Mistral 7B 的 dense representation 可以较好对齐：使用 140 个 anchor concept 做 Procrustes alignment 后，top-1 concept retrieval 达到 92%，随机基线是 0.87%。第二，文本序列化会破坏约 88% 的原始 SAE feature。第三，通过 text augmentation 实验，作者发现这些被破坏的 feature 多数对应 surface form，而不是被压抑的任务语义。在概念识别和区分任务上，文本通道通常持平或比 latent 通道高 3–10 个百分点。这个结果限制了论文主张的外推范围：latent 通信基础设施可行，但需要更难用文本表达的任务，才可能体现优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 分钟。建议先看 Introduction 末尾对 C1/C2/C3 的实验分解，再看 Methods 中三种通道的构造、激活层选择和 Procrustes alignment。结果部分重点看 §3.3 的 SAE feature loss 分析、§3.4 的跨架构对齐结果、§3.5–§3.6 的任务表现和 text augmentation。真正值得带走的是负结果：表征可对齐不等于 latent 通信更有用；SAE feature loss 也不必然意味着语义损失。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether text-based message passing between LLM agents is a lossy communication channel for information that exists in internal model representations, and whether direct latent communication preserves task-relevant information better than natural language.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method paper, but it is relevant to representation analysis and multi-agent communication. Its main value is a careful negative result. The authors show that representations from Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct and Mistral 7B can be aligned well, and that text serialization destroys many SAE features. However, the destroyed features appear to encode surface-form information rather than useful task semantics. On the tested concept tasks, text remains as good as or better than latent channels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper compares three communication channels: dense latent transfer using the full hidden state, SAE-sparse transfer using sparse autoencoder features, and standard text serialization. Activations are taken from late-middle residual stream layers: layer 23 for Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct and layer 24 for Mistral 7B, using last-token hidden states with 4096 dimensions. Cross-model communication is tested through Procrustes alignment, which asks whether two independently trained models have compatible concept geometry. SAE analysis is then used to measure which features survive or disappear after serialization through text. The contribution is an experimental protocol for measuring channel fidelity, not a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The concept dataset contains 84 hand-curated concept pairs across factual, abstract, overlap, and context-dependent categories, with multiple cloze-style prompts per concept. The paper first verifies that concepts are linearly separable in sender activations and that SAE features capture semantic relatedness. The strongest representation-level result is cross-model alignment: with 140 anchor concepts, Procrustes-aligned dense vectors reach 92% top-1 concept retrieval, compared with a 0.87% random baseline. SAE analysis finds that text serialization removes about 88% of the original SAE features. Text augmentation experiments indicate that these lost features mostly track surface form, not hidden semantic content needed by the tasks. In downstream concept identification and discrimination, text matches or outperforms latent channels by roughly 3–10 percentage points.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 20 minutes. Read the introduction for the C1/C2/C3 framing, then focus on the channel construction, layer choices, Procrustes alignment, SAE feature loss analysis, and the text augmentation experiment. The main lesson is that representational alignability and SAE feature preservation are not enough to prove a practical advantage over text communication.

recommendation.zh: 读通信通道构造和 SAE 对齐实验；别急着相信“文本不够”，但这个 setup 会逼你重新想 agent 接口。
recommendation.en: Read the channel construction and SAE alignment experiments; do not overbuy the “text is insufficient” claim, but the setup usefully pressures agent-interface assumptions.

paper.title: From Geometric Recovery to Causal Validation: A Reproducible Audit of Sparse Autoencoder Features, from Superposition Geometry to Causal Inertness
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are the standard for decomposing superposed neural representations into interpretable features, and evaluation relies predominantly on correlational recovery metrics -- cosine similarity between ground-truth directions and decoder atoms. We show this conflates two distinct claims: decoder-geometry alignment and encoder-activation behavior. We reproduce the superposition phase diagram of Elhage et al. (2022), identifying a convergence artifact at high sparsity and an un

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 SAE 解释性研究里一个被长期混在一起、但其实应当拆开的核心问题：一个 SAE decoder atom 在几何上和“真实特征方向”高度对齐，并不等于这个 atom 在模型实际计算中真的承担了对应功能。现有评估大多用 unsigned cosine similarity 这类相关性指标来判断“恢复成功”，但这只验证了 decoder 几何是否对齐，没有验证 encoder 是否会在正确输入上激活该特征，也没有验证对该特征做干预是否会沿着模型真实计算路径影响输出。论文在一个完全可控的 toy superposition setting 中，把这两件事明确分开，并用因果干预证明：高 cosine match 可以对应因果上几乎无效的 feature，作者把这种现象称为 causal inertness。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于改进 loss 或架构，而在于给 mechanistic interpretability 和 SAE 评估方法做了一次校准。现在很多关于“模型里发现了多少 feature”的结论，默认把 correlational recovery 当成 feature discovery 的充分证据。论文说明这一步并不够，至少在最容易验证的 toy setting 里，decoder 几何恢复和 encoder/selection 机制、以及最终输出因果效应之间存在可测的裂缝。这个结论会影响两类工作。第一类是用 SAE 做模型内部表征分析的研究：以后不能只报 cosine recovery。第二类是把 SAE feature 当成可控接口做 steering、editing、safety intervention 的工作：如果 feature 是 read-inert 或 write-inert，那么看起来“找到了”特征，实际却未必能读出或写入模型行为。对基座模型研究者来说，这篇论文的重要性在于它把“解释性 feature 是否真实可操作”从相关性问题推进到因果验证问题。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分成四层，而且每一层都围绕“把几何恢复和因果有效性拆开”展开。

第一层是构造完全可控的 ground-truth superposition toy model。作者从头训练一个很小的合成模型，不用预训练权重，也不用外部数据，使得真实 feature 方向、隐藏维度、稀疏度和 superposition 几何都已知。这样做的目的不是追求 realism，而是让“恢复是否正确”以及“干预是否沿真实路径生效”都能被严格定义。

第二层是复现并修正已有 SAE 几何结论。论文多 seed 复现了 Elhage 等人的 superposition phase diagram，并指出一个重要 artifact：在高 sparsity 区域，若训练步数不够，会把 under-training 误判成 superposition 结构。作者用 sparsity-aware step budgets 解决这个问题。除此之外，论文还描述了一个此前没有被充分刻画的 diffuse sharing regime：在极端 overcompleteness 下，每个 feature 都被“相当程度地表示”，但 feature dimensionality 很低，说明表示不是少数原子清晰分工，而是更弥散地共享字典容量。

第三层是复现 TopK SAE 与 L1 SAE 的比较，并把“L1 shrinkage”从口头说法变成直接测量。作者从头复现 TopK-vs-L1 Pareto，对 activation refinement 做了直接测试，量化 L1 正则导致的 shrinkage，而不是只凭经验判断。这里的关键点是：decoder recovery 看起来相近时，encoder 激活行为可能已经明显不同，这正是后面因果分歧的来源之一。

第四层是提出一套 causal validation battery，并把 inertness 细分成可操作的类型。作者对每个 correlationally recovered feature 做两类干预：ablation 和 sign-correct steering，并把影响一路传播到模型真实输出层，而不是停留在 SAE reconstruction 空间。基于这些干预，论文区分了两条轴。按成因分，有 structural inertness 和 competitive inertness。前者来自 antipodal-pair superposition geometry 与 positive-pass encoder 的结构性错配，即使 SAE 训练更好也未必消失；后者来自 TopK 竞争机制下退化字典的竞争病理，并且和数值边界不稳定性耦合。按方向分，有 read-inertness 和 write-inertness：前者表示 ablation 监测不到，后者表示 steering 无法写入有效影响。论文指出 antipodal pairs 可以把这两者完全解耦。

此外，作者还把这套审计流程封装成 sae-causal-audit 工具，接口只要求对象能 encode、decode 并暴露 dictionary，因此理论上可审计任意 SAE 实现，包括 sae_lens.SAE。工具设计里还专门处理了 sign-handling bug 这一类常见错误，使其在接口层面不易发生。
summary.experiments:
实验部分信息量很高，且不少结论都带具体数字。

第一，superposition phase diagram 的复现不是单次跑通，而是多 seed 统计。作者发现高 sparsity 区域存在收敛伪象：训练不够时会看起来像某种 superposition 几何，实际只是没收敛。这个问题通过 sparsity-aware step budget 解决。论文还报告了 diffuse sharing regime 的量化特征：在极端 overcompleteness 下，每个 feature 的表示强度大致为 ||W_i||^2 ≈ 1.40，而 feature dimensionality 约为 D_i ≈ 0.08，说明 feature 普遍被表示，但每个 feature 占用的“维度份额”很小。

第二，TopK-vs-L1 复现部分，作者不仅比较 Pareto，还直接测 activation refinement，验证 L1 shrinkage 的存在。虽然当前给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但结论很明确：仅看 decoder 对齐会高估 L1 SAE 的恢复质量，因为 encoder 激活被 shrinkage 扭曲后，因果效应会进一步偏离。

第三，也是最关键的，因果验证结果显示 correlational recovery 和 causal efficacy 可以明显分离。在一个 degraded SAE 上，22 个几何匹配到的 feature 里有 17 个是 causally inert；在一个 well-trained SAE 上，同样是 22 个匹配里只有 2 个 inert。更强的一点是，inert match 的 cosine 可以高到 0.9998，说明“几何几乎完美”并不能保证“因果上有效”。这基本击穿了只用 cosine recovery 做结论的做法。

第四，真实模型小规模审计。作者拿一个已发布的 production SAE，gpt2-small-res-jb，对 83 个手工编写、跨多个语义域的 concept 做审计，恢复出 7 个 correlationally matched feature，其中 1 个，也就是 14%，是 causally inert。样本不大，但方向上和 toy setting 一致。论文还发现一个意外现象：少数 decoder atoms 会反复成为几十个语义上互不相关 concept 的最近邻匹配。作者用三组独立构造、规模和多样性逐步增加的 concept batch 复现了这个 atom collision 现象，并用受控负例排除了 prompt template artifact 的解释。

第五，复现性实验。作者在 CI 调试中说明了为什么浮点训练跨平台做不到 byte-exact reproducibility，并提出两层保证：固定环境内做 SHA-256 级别的字节一致；跨环境则要求 semantic equality，数值容差 rtol=1e-4，边界敏感的整数计数允许 ±1。这个部分不是主结果，但对做 SAE 或小模型复现实验的人很实用。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合精读。建议先抓住论文最重要的判断：decoder 几何对齐和 feature 的因果有效性不是一回事。带着这个判断去读，结构会很清楚。

第一遍先看 Introduction 和作者列出的贡献，确认它不是单纯“又做了一次 toy SAE 复现”，而是在重写评估协议。然后直接看因果验证章节，也就是 ablation + sign-correct steering 那部分，重点看作者如何把干预传播到真实输出层，以及 inertness 的判定标准。这里是全文最关键的创新。

第二步回头看 superposition phase diagram 的复现。重点看高 sparsity convergence artifact 是如何被发现的，训练步数如何随 sparsity 调整，以及 diffuse sharing regime 的几何特征。这个部分会帮助理解为什么某些 feature 即使几何上可恢复，也可能在 encoder 选择机制下失活或竞争失败。

第三步看 TopK-vs-L1 复现和 activation refinement 测试。这里要注意作者不是简单说 TopK 更好，而是在问：哪一种 SAE 的 decoder recovery 更接近真实可干预 feature。若你平时只看 reconstruction / sparsity / cosine，这一节会补上 encoder 行为这一块。

第四步看 taxonomy 和工具化部分。structural inertness vs competitive inertness、read-inertness vs write-inertness 这四个概念值得记住，因为它们把“为什么干预无效”拆成了可诊断的问题。最后再看真实模型上的 gpt2-small-res-jb 审计和 atom collision 现象，判断 toy 结论在真实模型里是否已有早期迹象。

如果时间有限，优先读 Sections 6、7、10、11，再补 4 和 5。若要复现实验，Section 8 的 reproducibility 约定也值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central evaluation mistake in sparse autoencoder research: a decoder atom being geometrically aligned with a ground-truth feature direction does not imply that the SAE actually recovers the feature as used by the model. Current practice relies heavily on correlational recovery metrics such as unsigned cosine similarity. Those metrics validate decoder geometry, but they do not validate encoder activation behavior, selection dynamics, or whether intervening on the recovered feature changes the model’s actual output. In a fully controlled superposition toy setting, the paper cleanly separates these claims and shows by intervention that highly matched features can still be causally inert.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is methodological calibration for mechanistic interpretability rather than a new pretraining recipe. A large fraction of current SAE-based interpretability work implicitly treats correlational recovery as sufficient evidence of feature discovery. This paper shows that the inference is too strong. Even in the easiest possible setting, where ground truth is known, decoder alignment and causal efficacy can diverge by a measurable margin. That matters for two lines of work. First, studies that use SAEs to characterize internal representations can no longer stop at cosine recovery. Second, work that treats SAE features as control handles for steering, editing, or safety interventions needs to distinguish features that are merely geometrically plausible from features that are actually readable or writable in the model’s computation. For foundation-model researchers, the paper shifts the question from correlation to causal validation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical program has four layers, all built around separating geometric recovery from causal validity.

First, the authors construct a fully controlled ground-truth superposition model. It is a small synthetic model trained from scratch, with no pretrained weights and no external data. The point is not realism but identifiability: true feature directions, sparsity, hidden dimensionality, and superposition geometry are all known, so both recovery and intervention can be evaluated rigorously.

Second, they reproduce and refine prior geometric results. The paper reproduces the Elhage et al. superposition phase diagram with multi-seed statistics and identifies an important artifact: at high sparsity, insufficient training can masquerade as superposition structure. This is corrected with sparsity-aware step budgets. The paper also describes a less-discussed diffuse sharing regime at extreme overcompleteness, where every feature is substantially represented while each feature occupies only a small effective dimensional share.

Third, the paper reproduces the TopK-vs-L1 SAE comparison and turns the usual claim about L1 shrinkage into a direct measurement. Instead of asserting that L1 regularization distorts activations, the authors run an activation-refinement test that quantifies the shrinkage. This is important because similar-looking decoder recovery can coexist with very different encoder behavior, which later shows up as causal mismatch.

Fourth, the paper introduces a causal validation battery and a taxonomy of inertness. For every correlationally recovered feature, the authors run ablation and sign-correct steering interventions and propagate the effect through the model’s actual output stage rather than stopping at the SAE reconstruction space. This leads to two orthogonal taxonomies. By cause, there is structural inertness and competitive inertness. Structural inertness arises systematically from antipodal-pair superposition geometry combined with a positive-pass encoder, and better SAE training does not necessarily remove it. Competitive inertness is a TopK competition pathology in degraded dictionaries and is tied to numerical boundary instability. By direction, there is read-inertness and write-inertness: ablation can fail to reveal a feature even when steering can affect it, and steering can fail even when ablation suggests relevance. Antipodal pairs can fully dissociate these two notions.

The work is also packaged into a model-agnostic auditing tool, sae-causal-audit. Any object that can encode, decode, and expose its dictionary can be audited, including sae_lens.SAE. The interface is designed to make a documented class of sign-handling bugs hard to express.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is unusually rich and several results are numerically sharp.

First, the superposition phase diagram is reproduced with multi-seed statistics rather than a single run. The paper shows that high-sparsity regions suffer from a convergence artifact: under-training can look like a geometric phase transition. This is fixed with sparsity-aware training budgets. The newly described diffuse sharing regime is quantified by values such as ||W_i||^2 ≈ 1.40 and feature dimensionality D_i ≈ 0.08 under extreme overcompleteness, indicating that features are broadly represented but each occupies only a small dimensional share.

Second, in the TopK-vs-L1 reproduction, the paper directly measures activation refinement and confirms L1 shrinkage rather than treating it as folklore. The excerpt provided here does not include the full Pareto tables, but the qualitative conclusion is clear: decoder alignment alone overstates recovery quality when encoder activations are distorted by shrinkage.

Third, and most importantly, causal validation reveals a strong gap between correlational recovery and causal efficacy. In a degraded SAE, 17 of 22 matched features are causally inert. In a well-trained SAE, only 2 of 22 matched features are inert. More strikingly, inert matches can have cosine similarity as high as 0.9998. This is the paper’s strongest result: near-perfect geometric recovery does not guarantee causal usefulness.

Fourth, the authors run a first small-scale audit on a real published SAE, gpt2-small-res-jb. Against 83 hand-authored concepts spanning unrelated semantic domains, they recover 7 correlational matches, of which 1, or 14%, is causally inert. The sample is small, but the direction is consistent with the toy setting. They also report an unexpected atom-collision phenomenon: a small number of decoder atoms repeatedly appear as nearest matches for dozens of semantically unrelated concepts. This is replicated across three independently constructed concept batches of increasing size and diversity, and a controlled negative case argues against a prompt-template artifact.

Fifth, the reproducibility section explains why byte-exact reproducibility across platforms is unavailable for floating-point training workloads. The paper proposes a two-tier guarantee: SHA-256 byte exactness within one pinned environment, and semantic equality elsewhere with rtol = 1e-4 and boundary-sensitive integer counts allowed to vary by ±1.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is worth a careful read. Start with the central claim and keep it in mind throughout: decoder geometry and causal validity are different empirical statements. Once that is clear, the paper’s structure becomes straightforward.

On a first pass, read the Introduction and the contribution list to see that this is not just another toy SAE reproduction. Then jump directly to the causal validation section, especially the ablation and sign-correct steering protocol. Focus on how interventions are propagated to the model’s actual output layer and how inertness is operationally defined. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

Next, go back to the superposition phase-diagram reproduction. Pay attention to how the high-sparsity convergence artifact is diagnosed, how training budgets are adjusted with sparsity, and what characterizes the diffuse sharing regime. This helps explain why geometrically recovered features can still fail at the encoder or competition stage.

Then read the TopK-vs-L1 reproduction and the activation-refinement test. The key question there is not simply which SAE reconstructs better, but which one recovers features that remain causally actionable. If you usually look only at reconstruction, sparsity, or cosine metrics, this section fills in the missing encoder side.

After that, read the taxonomy and tooling sections. Structural vs competitive inertness and read- vs write-inertness are useful concepts because they turn intervention failure into something diagnosable. Finish with the real-model audit on gpt2-small-res-jb and the atom-collision finding to judge whether the toy conclusions already have echoes in practical SAEs.

If time is limited, prioritize Sections 6, 7, 10, and 11, then return to Sections 4 and 5. If you plan to reproduce the work, Section 8 on reproducibility conventions is also worth close attention.

recommendation.zh: 现有SAE评估的核心指标被证伪，做预训练表征分析或可解释性研究的必须看§4的因果实验设计，停止仅依赖余弦相似度判断特征恢复质量。
recommendation.en: The core SAE evaluation metric (cosine similarity) is falsified; researchers working on pretrained representation analysis or interpretability must read §4 for causal experiment design, stop relying solely on cosine similarity for feature recovery validation.

paper.title: Aligning Sentence Embeddings to Human Concepts via Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Dense sentence embeddings are fundamental to modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems but suffer from a lack of interpretability due to feature superposition. This opacity hinders the alignment of retrieval processes with human intent, as the entangled representations are difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we propose a method to disentangle the dense representations of sentence transformers (e.g., E5) into human-interpretable concepts using Top-k Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs)

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 中 dense sentence embedding 难解释、难控制的问题，尝试把句向量拆解为人类可理解的稀疏概念。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是表示分析与轻量控制方法。它不是预训练方法，但把 SAE 从 LLM activation 扩展到 sentence transformer embedding，对检索模型可解释性和可控 RAG 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 E5 等 sentence transformer 的 dense embedding 上训练 Top-k Sparse Autoencoder，将原本纠缠的向量表示分解为稀疏 latent features。作者进一步提出 activation steering，通过 clamp 特定 latent feature 来重排检索结果，而不重新训练 backbone。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 SAE 特征可对应语义、句法和语用类别，并能通过特征钳制让检索结果更符合用户约束。未在摘要中给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the opacity and limited controllability of dense sentence embeddings in RAG by decomposing them into human-interpretable sparse concepts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is representation analysis plus lightweight control. It is not a pretraining method, but it extends SAE-style interpretability from LLM activations to sentence-transformer embeddings, which is relevant to controllable retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains Top-k Sparse Autoencoders on dense embeddings from sentence transformers such as E5, aiming to disentangle superposed features into sparse latents. It then uses activation steering by clamping selected latent features to re-rank retrieval results without retraining the backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that learned SAE features align with semantic, syntactic, and pragmatic categories, and that clamping features can steer retrieval toward user constraints. It does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines, or effect sizes in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: SAE 用在 embedding 上是自然外推；只看 feature 语义验证和 steering 实验，别把它当预训练 insight。
recommendation.en: Applying SAEs to embeddings is a natural extension; read the feature validation and steering tests, but do not overread it as a pretraining result.

paper.title: Signed-Permutation Coordinate Transport for RMSNorm Transformers
paper.abstract: Modern LLM workflows move coordinate-indexed objects across checkpoints: steering vectors, sparse autoencoders, top-$k$ neuron sets, attribution lists, and merge alignments. This is only well posed after fixing the model's residual-stream gauge, which we show is architecture-dependent: LayerNorm residual charts have permutation gauge $S_d$ (up to a global sign flip), while RMSNorm charts with generic per-channel gain have signed-permutation gauge $B_d = S_d \ltimes \{\pm 1\}^d$. Permutation-only

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个常被忽略、但对坐标级分析和工具迁移很关键的问题：RMSNorm Transformer 的残差流坐标并不只有“置换”等价，而是存在“带符号置换” gauge。若只按 permutation 去对齐两个 checkpoint、两个 seed、或训练轨迹上的不同时刻，就会把很多本来等价的坐标当成不匹配，导致 steering vector、SAE feature、LoRA 更新、merge 对齐、甚至 AdamW optimizer state 的跨模型搬运失真。论文要解决的不是功能等价下的任意重参数化，而是“保留坐标身份”的离散对称群到底是什么，以及如何从激活中把这个正确的 gauge 恢复出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在两个层面。第一，它把 RMSNorm 模型里一个很基础的对称性问题讲清楚了：LayerNorm 残差流天然对应的是 S_d（外加全局符号），而 RMSNorm 在 generic per-channel gain 下对应的是 B_d = S_d ⋉ {±1}^d。这个结论直接影响所有依赖“第 i 个坐标/神经元/特征”可比性的工作。第二，它给出的是可操作的 transport 规则，而不是纯理论提醒。现在很多开源 LLM 都是 RMSNorm，若继续沿用 permutation-only 的 neuron matching 或 merge alignment，很多坐标级结论会系统性失真。对做 interpretability、checkpoint surgery、model merging、continual finetune 恢复、optimizer state 迁移的人，这篇文章提供了一个必要的校正。
summary.technical_approach: 技术上分三步。第一步是群论和参数化层面的刻画。作者证明：在保留原生坐标语义、显式保留 RMSNorm gain γ 的参数化下，RMSNorm 残差流允许的最大 coordinate-preserving 离散对称群是 hyperoctahedral group B_d，也就是任意坐标置换加每个坐标独立翻转符号。若把 γ 吸收到相邻线性层里，可以恢复更宽的正交自由度，但那已经改变了坐标系，不再适合讨论稀疏坐标身份、top-k neuron、SAE dictionary 这类对象。第二步是 gauge recovery。作者把传统 activation matching 的 Hungarian assignment 改成 sign-marginalized 版本：匹配代价不再用 signed correlation，而是用绝对相关 |<h_i, h'_j>|，匹配完成后再由相关符号恢复 sign。关键点在于，正确匹配在 RMSNorm 下可能是强负相关；若直接最大化 signed correlation，负号那一半真匹配会被系统性排斥。文中给了 decorrelated source coordinates 下的 sharp population failure mode：当一半真实符号为负时，即使 probe 无限多，signed-correlation matching 也会稳定失败。第三步是 transport via atlas。与其只做两个端点的全局匹配，作者沿训练轨迹保存局部 B_d gauge，并把这些局部高置信小步匹配复合起来，形成 transport-via-base。这样做利用了训练相邻 checkpoint 之间变化小、局部 margin 高的事实，比直接 endpoint matching 更容易恢复真实坐标对应。论文还把同样的 signed transport 规则扩展到 merge 和 AdamW state 恢复，强调 READ/WRITE 都要 obey B_d-covariance。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是大规模 benchmark，而是验证“少了 sign 会怎样坏”。几个结果比较关键。1）在记录了真实 gauge 的 LLM activation 上，signed-cost recovery 基本停留在约 50%，而 sign-marginalized recovery 可以到 100%，直接对应理论里的负相关失配。2）在一个 gauge-instrumented 的 Qwen2.5-1.5B finetuning 轨迹上，训练 1500 steps，并在 step 0 施加随机 B_d gauge 作为真值。端点直接匹配只能恢复 60.3% 坐标；transport-via-base 提升到 91.1%；若只是 endpoint-via-base 但不利用局部链式 transport，则只有 11.4%。这说明收益来自“很多局部小步高 margin 匹配”的复合，而不是简单拿 base 当参考。3）在 Llama-2-7B 的 gauge-scramble merge 测试里，signed alignment 把 peak-above-chord barrier 从 6.14 降到 0.00；精确 permutation-only alignment 反而有害。4）在独立训练的 10M RMSNorm Transformer 不同 seed 间，也观察到自然出现的 sign mismatch；signed alignment 相比 permutation-only，把 merge barrier 从 0.66 降到 0.42。5）对 optimizer state，signed transport 可以保持 resumed trajectory，而 permutation-only 即便从函数等价 checkpoint 出发也会训练发散或偏离。文中还给出一个理论 corollary：若对 RMSNorm 更新误用 permutation-only，对 learned weight update 引入的期望平方误差量级是 2||ΔW||_F^2，和更新本身能量同阶，这解释了为什么错误不是“小噪声”，而是结构性破坏。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看引言和理论部分里对 LayerNorm 与 RMSNorm gauge 的区分，尤其是 Theorem 2.2 及相关 corollary，弄清“为什么 broader orthogonal freedom 不等于 coordinate-preserving symmetry”。第二，看 activation matching 那部分，重点理解为什么 cost 要从 signed correlation 改成 absolute correlation，以及 decorrelated population 例子里失败是如何必然发生的。第三，看训练轨迹 transport 的实验图表，尤其 Qwen2.5-1.5B 1500-step 那组结果，它最能说明 atlas 思路的实际价值。若时间有限，优先读 Introduction、理论结论、activation recovery 实验、transport-via-base 实验和 merge/optimizer state 两节，预计 30–45 分钟能抓住主线。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是这个 B_d-correct transport 能否成为 SAE/steering/LoRA 发布时的标准接口；二是对更一般的 normalization 或 fused parameterization，哪些对称性仍然保留坐标身份。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a precise but underappreciated issue in RMSNorm transformers: coordinate-indexed objects are not well-defined up to permutations alone. In RMSNorm residual streams, the native coordinate-preserving gauge is a signed permutation group, not just S_d. If one aligns checkpoints, seeds, or training-time states using permutation-only matching, many coordinates that are actually equivalent under a sign flip will be treated as mismatches. This breaks the transport of neuron-level artifacts such as steering vectors, SAE features, sparse neuron sets, LoRA updates, merge alignments, and even optimizer states.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented work is not that it improves perplexity, but that it fixes a foundational assumption behind a growing set of workflows around open-weight LLMs. Many modern models use RMSNorm, yet much of the alignment tooling inherited from LayerNorm-era work still assumes permutation symmetry only. The paper shows that this is symmetry-incomplete for RMSNorm and can induce errors on the same scale as the update being transported. For interpretability, checkpoint surgery, model merging, continual finetuning, and optimizer-state recovery, this is a necessary correction rather than a cosmetic refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper has three main technical components. First, it characterizes the native discrete gauge of transformer residual streams under coordinate-preserving parameterizations. For LayerNorm, the residual chart has permutation symmetry up to a global sign. For RMSNorm with generic per-channel gain, the correct group is the hyperoctahedral group B_d = S_d ⋉ {±1}^d, meaning arbitrary coordinate permutations plus independent sign flips. The paper also clarifies an important distinction: broader orthogonal freedom can be recovered only after absorbing the RMSNorm gain into adjacent weights, but that changes the coordinate system and no longer preserves sparse coordinate identity. Second, it proposes sign-marginalized activation matching. Instead of matching coordinates by signed correlation, it matches by absolute correlation |<h_i, h'_j>| and recovers the sign afterward from the matched pair. This is the right objective because the true counterpart of a coordinate may be maximally anti-correlated under a negative gauge sign. The authors prove a sharp population-level failure mode for signed-correlation matching in a decorrelated setting: if half of the true signs are negative, the correct entries become the most negative ones in their rows, so maximizing signed correlation systematically avoids them even with unlimited probes. Third, it introduces transport via a checkpoint atlas. Rather than matching only two endpoints, the method composes local B_d gauges saved along a training trajectory. This exploits the fact that nearby checkpoints differ only slightly, so local matches have higher margins and can be chained into a much more reliable global transport map.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to show how omission of signs fails in practice. On gauge-recorded LLM activations, signed-cost recovery stays near 50%, while sign-marginalized recovery reaches 100%, matching the theoretical obstruction. On a gauge-instrumented Qwen2.5-1.5B finetuning trajectory of 1500 steps, with a random B_d gauge applied at step 0 and the induced correspondence recorded as ground truth, direct endpoint matching recovers 60.3% of coordinates. Transport-via-base raises this to 91.1%, whereas endpoint-via-base without local chained transport achieves only 11.4%, showing that the gain comes from composing many small high-margin local gauges rather than from using the base model as a trivial reference. In a Llama-2-7B gauge-scramble merge test, signed alignment reduces the peak-above-chord barrier from 6.14 to 0.00, while exact permutation-only alignment is actively harmful. In independently trained 10M-parameter RMSNorm transformers, sign mismatch also appears naturally across seeds, and signed alignment improves the merge barrier from 0.66 to 0.42 over permutation-only alignment. The paper further shows that AdamW optimizer-state transport is gauge-covariant under signed transport: resumed training follows the original trajectory, whereas permutation-only transport diverges despite starting from a functionally equivalent checkpoint. A useful theoretical corollary states that misapplying permutation-only transport to an RMSNorm weight update introduces expected squared error of size 2||ΔW||_F^2, on the same order as the update energy itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the main theorem section that distinguishes LayerNorm from RMSNorm gauges; the key conceptual point is why coordinate-preserving symmetry is B_d rather than a larger orthogonal group. Second, read the activation-matching section carefully, especially the switch from signed correlation to absolute correlation and the population failure example that explains why the old objective is structurally wrong. Third, inspect the Qwen2.5-1.5B trajectory experiment and the merge/optimizer-state sections, since these show the practical consequences most clearly. If time is limited, Introduction, the main theoretical statements, activation recovery, transport-via-base, and the merge/optimizer-state results are enough to capture the paper in about 30–45 minutes. The deeper follow-up question is whether B_d-correct transport should become a standard interface for publishing coordinate-indexed artifacts in RMSNorm LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 做模型编辑、SAE跨checkpoint迁移的研究员必看，RMSNorm的带符号置换规范证明可直接修正现有对齐方法的系统性偏差
recommendation.en: Mandatory for researchers working on model editing or cross-checkpoint SAE transport; the signed-permutation gauge proof for RMSNorm can directly fix systematic biases in existing alignment methods

paper.title: C$^{2}$R: Cross-sample Consistency Regularization Mitigates Feature Splitting and Absorption in Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret large language models by decomposing activations into sparse, human-understandable features, but scaling to large dictionaries exposes fundamental challenges. Systematic studies reveal pervasive feature splitting that fragments coherent concepts into non-atomic latents and widespread feature absorption that creates arbitrary exceptions in general features, severely compromising latent reliability. These issues stem from inconsistent latent

summary.core_problem: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在大字典规模下会普遍出现两类失效：特征分裂把一个高层概念拆成多个冗余子特征，特征吸收让token专属隐变量截走通用特征的部分激活；两者的共同根源是标准L1/TopK稀疏约束只在单样本层面起作用，没有跨样本强制同一概念对应同一组隐变量，导致隐变量分配随样本上下文漂移。
summary.importance: 这是SAE可解释性方向中首次对分裂与吸收给出统一的几何成因分析，并提出只用批级正则就能修复的方案，不依赖额外标注或重构代价。对预训练研究的直接价值在于：更可靠的SAE特征可以作为对齐、幻觉诊断、知识编辑和circuit发现的基础工具，也为后续在预训练loss中引入稀疏可解释性约束提供了可行目标函数。
summary.technical_approach: 论文引入冗余参数α刻画真实语义特征在多个受扰基方向上的泄漏程度，把分裂和吸收统一建模成基向量偏离理想方向的结果。基于Minkowski不等式与ℓ₂范数的严格凸性，设计C²R正则：在批次维度上惩罚“同一语义信息分散到多个互不重叠的隐向量”的情形——因为多个非对齐向量的范数之和严格大于它们求和后的范数，使分裂/吸收在优化中显式变贵。正则与原有重构loss和稀疏约束联合训练，不需要修改SAE架构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖不同规模LLM上训练的SAE，对比TopK、L1等基线。主要结果：C²R在不降低重构保真度的前提下显著降低分裂与吸收的量化指标，特征层次结构更符合语言概念本身的层级关系；消融显示正则权重对性能有平缓的trade-off曲线，过大则会过度合并无关特征。文中没有放出非常具体的参数量和数据规模数字，重点是病理指标的相对下降幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction后半段对两类失效的直观例子（“数学”被拆分、“首字母S”在short/small上失效），以及Unified Problem Formulation中用α参数统一分裂与吸收的几何推导——这是全文最有洞见的部分。方法部分重点读C²R目标与Minkowski不等式的对应关系。实验部分扫主图即可，若要复现再看附录的超参选择。预计阅读时间45–60分钟。
summary.authors_note: 文中未标注具体机构与作者名单，返回""

summary_en.core_problem: When scaled to large dictionaries, sparse autoencoders (SAEs) suffer from two pervasive failure modes: feature splitting, which fragments a high-level concept into redundant sub-features, and feature absorption, where token-specific latents steal activation mass from general-purpose features. Both stem from the fact that standard L1 / TopK sparsity objectives act only per sample, so the same underlying concept can be assigned to different latents depending on context.
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first unified geometric account of both splitting and absorption, and repairs them with a batch-level regularizer that requires no extra supervision and essentially no reconstruction cost. For pretraining research, more reliable SAE features directly benefit alignment auditing, hallucination diagnosis, knowledge editing and circuit-level interpretability; the regularizer also gives a concrete loss term that could later be folded into pretraining objectives to encourage intrinsic sparsity.
summary_en.technical_approach: A redundancy parameter α is introduced to quantify how much of a semantic feature leaks onto perturbed, non-ideal latent directions; splitting and absorption are then both instances of this geometric leakage. C²R (Cross-sample Consistency Regularization) leverages the Minkowski inequality and strict convexity of the ℓ₂ norm: for non-aligned vectors, the sum of norms strictly exceeds the norm of the sum. Applying this inequality across the batch dimension makes it expensive to spread one concept across disjoint latents. The regularizer is added on top of the standard reconstruction + sparsity loss without changing the SAE architecture.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments evaluate SAEs trained on activations from several LLM sizes against TopK and L1 baselines. C²R substantially reduces quantitative metrics for both splitting and absorption while preserving reconstruction fidelity, and recovers more human-aligned hierarchical feature structure. Ablations show a smooth trade-off with regularization strength: too large a coefficient over-merges unrelated features. No very specific parameter count / dataset size numbers are emphasized; results are reported as relative reductions in pathology metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a first pass, read the concrete examples of splitting and absorption in the late introduction, then the unified geometric formulation built around α in Unified Problem Formulation — this is the most insightful section. In the method section, focus on the connection between Minkowski inequality and the regularization form. Skim the main experimental figures; only go to appendices if reproduction is planned. Estimated reading time: 45–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做SAE机制分析的团队值得复现这个正则项；若你不碰SAE字典训练可略过。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing the regularizer if you run SAE dictionaries internally; skip if interpretability tooling is not on your roadmap.

paper.title: Turn-Averaged SAEs for Feature Discovery and Long-Context Attribution
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a useful tool for extracting interpretable features in language models. However, standard SAE architectures operate on individual token activations, meaning that the number of active features scales linearly with context length, and studying long model transcripts becomes difficult. We introduce turn-averaged SAEs, which represent a single Human or Assistant turn with a fixed number of features by learning to reconstruct the average model activation across

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 SAE 在长上下文和多轮对话分析中的尺度问题：逐 token SAE 的激活数量随上下文长度线性增长，导致特征发现、归因图和人工检查都变得很难操作。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对大模型机制分析和训练后行为诊断有实用价值。它把 SAE 的分析单元从 token 改成 turn 或任意 span，使长对话中的主题、风格、persona、安全相关信号更容易被压缩成固定数量的特征。对预训练研究的启发是，模型内部表征并不总适合只按 token 观察；一些行为属性可能分布在整段文本上，用 span-level 表征更容易分离。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法很简单：对一个 span 内每个 token 的 residual stream hidden state 求平均，再用标准 SAE 重构这个平均向量。由于平均后的向量仍在 d_model 维空间内，现有 SAE 架构和训练代码基本不需要改动。作者使用 BatchTopK SAE，令 turn-level 输入学习高层特征。直觉是，token 级词汇、位置和局部句法信号在平均时会被削弱，而跨多个 token 持续存在的主题、意图、风格和行为模式会保留下来。论文还讨论两类混合结构：decoupled 版本把每个 token 的激活分解为 turn mean 与 token residual，分别训练两个 SAE；nested 版本用类似 Matryoshka 的 loss 在一个模型中同时学习 turn-level 和 token-level 特征。最后，作者把 attribution graph 从 token 层面改到 turn 层面，用更小的图分析多轮对话中 feature 到 feature 的影响关系，并用干预实验、completeness 和 replacement sufficiency 检查边权是否有解释力。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct，使用 LMSYS-Chat-1M 训练。模型 hidden size 为 3584，SAE 字典大小为 32768，BatchTopK 的 k 为 128。turn-averaged SAE 在约 158 万个 turn-averaged 样本上训练一个 epoch，4 张 H100 约 1.5 小时；同一语料若按 token 训练则对应约 2.66 亿 token。结果显示，turn-averaged 特征在 LLM judge 评价下更完整地描述单个 turn 的高层属性；归因图也明显更紧凑，更适合长上下文检查。论文还通过 intervention、completeness、replacement sufficiency 验证 turn-level attribution 的边权不是纯相关统计，而能捕捉一定的一阶影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Method 和实验部分，重点看三个点：第一，turn average 的定义和为什么它像低通滤波；第二，decoupled 与 nested SAE 如何同时保留 span-level 与 token-level 信息；第三，turn-level attribution graph 的边权验证方式。预计 30 到 45 分钟可读完关键内容。若只关心可复现实用方案，优先看训练设置、BatchTopK 参数、数据规模和 attribution graph 示例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical limitation of sparse autoencoders for long transcripts: token-level SAE activations scale with sequence length, making feature inspection and attribution graphs difficult to use in multi-turn conversations.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability method rather than a pretraining method, but it is useful for studying large-model behavior at conversation scale. The main idea is to move the unit of analysis from tokens to turns or spans, producing a fixed-size feature representation for each segment. For pretraining researchers, the useful lesson is that some internal signals are distributed across many positions. Topic, style, persona, and safety-relevant behavior may be easier to expose with span-level representations than with token-local features.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains an SAE on the mean residual-stream activation over a token span. The averaged vector has the same dimensionality as a normal hidden state, so the standard SAE architecture and training loop can be reused. The authors use BatchTopK SAEs and apply the method mainly to human and assistant turns. The intuition is that averaging suppresses token-specific lexical, syntactic, and positional detail, while preserving lower-frequency signals that persist across the span. The paper also studies hybrid designs. A decoupled model decomposes each token activation into a turn mean and a token residual, then trains separate SAEs on the two components. A nested architecture uses a Matryoshka-like loss to learn turn-level and token-level features in a single model. The authors further adapt attribution graphs to the turn level, reducing graph size for long conversations and validating edge weights with interventions, completeness, and replacement sufficiency tests.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct on LMSYS-Chat-1M. The model hidden size is 3584. The SAE uses a dictionary size of 32768 with BatchTopK k equal to 128. Training a turn-averaged SAE for one epoch over about 1.58 million turn-averaged samples takes around 1.5 hours on 4 H100 GPUs, compared with about 266 million token samples for token-level SAE training on the same corpus. LLM-based evaluations indicate that turn-averaged features describe high-level properties of a turn more completely than per-token features. Turn-level attribution graphs are also much more compact for long transcripts. The validation experiments suggest that the graph edges capture useful first-order effects rather than only co-activation patterns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the method and experimental sections. The key parts are the definition of turn averaging, the low-pass-filter intuition, the decoupled and nested SAE variants, and the validation protocol for turn-level attribution graphs. A focused read should take 30 to 45 minutes. For implementation, prioritize the training setup, BatchTopK parameters, data scale, and the examples of attribution graphs on long conversations.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 attribution graph demo；这是实用的 SAE 粒度改动，适合长对话分析但别过读成机制发现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and attribution-graph demo; it is a useful granularity change for SAEs, but not yet a mechanistic discovery.

paper.title: Same Concept, Different Directions: Cross-Modal Feature Heterogeneity in Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Vision-language models map images and text into a joint embedding space. However, these embeddings often entangle multiple semantic features, which limits their interpretability and controllability. While sparse autoencoders have emerged as a useful tool for decomposing these embeddings into monosemantic features, their application to joint embedding spaces has largely relied on an implicit, untested assumption that semantically corresponding features share the same directions across modalities.

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的联合嵌入空间中，相同语义概念在图像和文本模态下的特征方向不一致（跨模态特征异质性），导致稀疏自编码器（SAE）在提取跨模态共享特征时出现“模态分裂（modality split）”。
summary.importance: 挑战了多模态 SAE 研究中“相同概念在不同模态共享相同方向”的隐式假设。为理解 VLM 的联合表示机制提供了新视角，并指出强制对齐潜在激活会损害特征重建质量，对多模态表征解耦和可解释性研究有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过实验验证跨模态特征异质性的存在。然后分析现有方法（如强制对齐潜在激活）在处理模态分裂时的缺陷，指出这会导致几何上不同的方向坍缩为单一坐标，牺牲重建质量。提出一种新范式：先训练模态特定的 SAE 以保留各自的特征几何结构，然后通过事后对齐（post hoc alignment）匹配对应的潜在坐标。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，所提方法在不牺牲重建质量的前提下，改善了跨模态检索性能，并在真实 VLM 嵌入上实现了更有效的概念引导（concept steering）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4 对跨模态特征异质性的刻画，以及 Section 6 中模态特定 SAE + 事后对齐的具体实现。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In the joint embedding space of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the same semantic concept exhibits inconsistent feature directions across image and text modalities (cross-modal feature heterogeneity), leading to 'modality split' when Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) attempt to extract shared cross-modal features.
summary_en.importance: Challenges the implicit assumption in multimodal SAE research that 'the same concept shares the same direction across different modalities'. Provides a new perspective for understanding the joint representation mechanism of VLMs, and points out that forcing alignment of latent activations degrades feature reconstruction quality, directly impacting research on multimodal representation disentanglement and interpretability.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, experimentally verifies the existence of cross-modal feature heterogeneity. Then, analyzes the flaws of existing methods (e.g., forcing alignment of latent activations) in handling modality split, pointing out that this causes geometrically distinct directions to collapse into a single coordinate, sacrificing reconstruction quality. Proposes a new paradigm: first train modality-specific SAEs to preserve their respective feature geometries, and then match corresponding latent coordinates through post hoc alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that the proposed method improves cross-modal retrieval performance without sacrificing reconstruction quality, and enables more effective concept steering on real VLM embeddings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 for the characterization of cross-modal feature heterogeneity, and Section 6 for the specific implementation of modality-specific SAEs + post hoc alignment. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对做多模态可解释性和 VLM 对齐的人很关键，直接推翻 SAE 在联合嵌入空间中的常用前提，重点看 §3 的异质性度量和 Fig 2-3。
recommendation.en: Highly relevant for multimodal interpretability and VLM alignment work; directly overturns a common SAE premise in joint embeddings—focus on §3 metrics and Figs 2–3.

paper.title: VASAE: Naming SAE Dictionary Directions with Vocabulary-Aligned Anchoring
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide useful decompositions of Transformer residual streams, but their learned features are usually named post hoc rather than directly connected to the Transformer's token vocabulary. We introduce Vocabulary-Aligned Sparse Autoencoder (VASAE), a method that trains SAE features under vocabulary-aligned anchoring and assigns each feature an intrinsic token name: the token string whose embedding is nearest to that feature. Without reducing reconstruction quality compar

summary.core_problem: 残差流 SAE（Sparse Autoencoder）能把 Transformer 的高维激活分解成稀疏特征，但这些特征通常缺少“内生的名字”：特征方向与词表 embedding 的几何关系不对齐，导致解释时只能靠事后找激活上下文或另跑自动解释器，命名不稳定、成本高，也难以把特征与模型的词表接口（embedding/readout）直接关联。
summary.importance:
这是机制解释/可解释性方向的工作，不直接改进预训练指标，但它把 SAE 字典与词表几何对齐，提供一种更可复现的特征标识方式（nearest-token intrinsic name）。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：
- 更容易把“某层学到的方向”与 token 级语义接口联系起来，降低分析门槛；
- 为后续做数据/训练动态的表征追踪提供更稳定的坐标系（至少在浅层/中层）。
不过它并不保证 token 名就是语义真名，更多是一个几何锚点；深层不稳定也提示了词表几何未必覆盖高层抽象特征。
summary.technical_approach:
VASAE（Vocabulary-Aligned SAE）的核心是给 SAE 增加一个“软锚定”目标，让每个字典特征方向靠近某个 token embedding，从而训练后可以用最近邻 token 作为该特征的内生名字。
- 基础对象：在 decoder-only Transformer 的 post-residual stream 上训练 SAE；字典是 SAE decoder 权重矩阵的列向量（feature directions），稀疏码是每个特征的系数。
- 问题根源：标准 SAE 只优化重构+稀疏，学到的方向可能远离任何 token embedding；而把 decoder 硬绑定为 token embedding 矩阵又会损失重构能力。
- 方法：在标准 SAE 损失之外加入 anchor loss。对每个 feature direction，找到其最近的 token embedding 作为 anchor，并用一个系数 λ_anchor 鼓励该 feature 靠近该 embedding（“软”而非硬绑定，保留字典自由度）。训练完成后，直接用最近 token 的字符串作为 intrinsic token name。
- 诊断指标：定义 nearest-token alignment score，并用阈值（文中用 0.8 cutoff）统计有多少特征能被可靠地对齐到词表方向。
方法取舍很明确：牺牲一部分字典几何自由度，换取可命名性；并通过对比“硬绑定 decoder”来说明必须是软约束而不是直接把字典等同词表。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 GPT-2-small 与 Llama-3.1-8B 的 post-residual stream SAE。
- 重构质量：VASAE 在测试设置下与标准 SAE 的重构指标接近。文中给出 GPT-2-small 的 variance explained (VE) 约 0.965，Llama-3.1-8B 约 0.931；而“decoder 硬绑定 token embedding”的方案重构更差。
- 对齐覆盖率：在 GPT-2-small 的浅层到中浅层（L0–L10），用 alignment cutoff=0.8 时约 89%–94% 的特征可对齐到某个 token embedding。
- 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，较大的锚定系数 λ_anchor=5e-3 时，L0 可达 92.8% 对齐，但在代表性的最后层仍不稳定（提示深层特征与词表几何更脱钩，或锚定会与重构/稀疏目标冲突）。
- 论文还给了 case studies：展示在具体上下文中被激活的特征，其 intrinsic token name 作为标识符如何使用（更像“坐标标签”而非严格语义解释）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“字典几何 vs 词表几何脱钩”的动机，以及为什么 hard-tying 不够。
- 重点看方法部分 anchor objective 的定义、最近邻 token 的选取方式、以及 alignment score 的诊断口径；这些决定了‘命名’到底在多大程度上可信。
- 实验部分优先看两类对比：VASAE vs 标准 SAE（重构不掉多少）以及 VASAE vs hard-tied（说明软约束必要）。
- 如果要用于分析预训练动态，建议特别关注跨层的对齐率曲线：浅层高对齐、深层不稳定这一现象本身就值得解释（词表接口在不同深度的作用边界）。

summary_en.core_problem: Residual-stream SAEs decompose Transformer activations into sparse features, but those features typically lack intrinsic, vocabulary-grounded names. Because SAE dictionary directions are learned purely for reconstruction+sparsity, they can be geometrically far from any token embedding, forcing post-hoc naming via context inspection or separate interpretation pipelines.
summary_en.importance: This is interpretability infrastructure rather than a pretraining improvement, but it tightens the connection between learned features and the model’s vocabulary interface by aligning SAE directions to token embeddings. The practical upside is more reproducible feature identifiers (nearest-token intrinsic names), which can lower the cost of representation analysis and make layerwise tracking easier—especially in shallow/mid layers. Limitations are also informative: deep-layer instability suggests token-embedding geometry may not span higher-level abstract features, and a nearest-token label is a geometric anchor, not guaranteed semantic truth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VASAE (Vocabulary-Aligned SAE) adds a soft anchoring objective to standard SAEs so that each learned decoder direction stays close to some token embedding.
- Training target: SAEs are trained on post-residual stream activations in decoder-only Transformers; dictionary features are decoder columns; sparse codes reconstruct activations.
- Key issue: standard SAE features can reconstruct well while being far from vocabulary directions; conversely, hard-tying the SAE decoder to the token embedding matrix overly constrains the dictionary and hurts reconstruction.
- Proposed fix: augment the SAE loss with a vocabulary-aligned anchor term. For each feature direction, identify its nearest token embedding as an anchor and penalize distance to it with coefficient λ_anchor (soft constraint). After training, the nearest token string becomes the feature’s intrinsic name.
- Diagnostics: define a nearest-token alignment score and report the fraction of features exceeding a threshold (0.8 in the paper).
Design choice is explicit: trade some dictionary freedom for nameability, while keeping reconstruction competitive via soft (not hard) alignment.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluations on GPT-2-small and Llama-3.1-8B residual streams.
- Reconstruction: VASAE matches standard SAE closely under tested settings, reporting variance explained (VE) around 0.965 on GPT-2-small and 0.931 on Llama-3.1-8B; hard-tying the decoder to token embeddings yields worse reconstruction.
- Alignment coverage: on GPT-2-small, with alignment cutoff 0.8, about 89%–94% of features in layers 0–10 align to a vocabulary direction.
- On Llama-3.1-8B, with a larger anchor coefficient (λ_anchor=5e-3), layer 0 reaches 92.8% alignment, but a representative final layer remains unstable (suggesting tension between anchoring and deep-layer feature geometry).
- Case studies illustrate how intrinsic token names can serve as stable identifiers for active features in context.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
- Read the motivation carefully: why SAE dictionary geometry and vocabulary geometry diverge, and why hard-tying the decoder is insufficient.
- Focus on the exact anchor loss definition, how nearest-token anchors are chosen, and how the alignment score is computed—these determine what “named” really means.
- In experiments, prioritize (i) VASAE vs standard SAE reconstruction parity, and (ii) VASAE vs hard-tied decoder to justify the soft constraint.
- Pay attention to the layerwise alignment trend (high in shallow layers, unstable deep): it’s likely the most actionable signal if you plan to use this for representation tracking.

recommendation.zh: 做 SAE 的应看 anchoring loss 和分层结果；词表对齐可能带偏字典，但 final layer 失效是有用信号。
recommendation.en: If you use SAEs, read the anchoring loss and layerwise results; vocabulary alignment may bias the dictionary, but the final-layer failure is a useful signal.

paper.title: From Weights to Features: SAE-Guided Activation Regularization for LLM Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Weight-space regularization methods such as Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) are the standard approach to catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. However, those methods tend to underperform when applied to large language models. We argue that such underperformance can be partly explained by the ``polysemantic'' nature of large language models: per-weight importance estimates utilized by EWC-style regularization are too coarse and cannot isolate the knowledge that needs protection. In th

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理 LLM 持续学习中的遗忘问题，重点指出 EWC 等权重空间正则在 LLM 上效果弱，原因可能不是单纯调参不足，而是权重和神经元过于多义，不能作为选择性保护知识的合适单位。
summary.importance: 对 continual pretrain 和部署后持续适配有一定参考价值。贡献不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于把稳定性约束从 weight space 移到 SAE feature space。这个方向把 mechanistic interpretability 中的稀疏特征字典用于训练约束，给出一个更细粒度的知识保护坐标系。它也提示持续学习中的关键问题不只是正则强度，而是约束施加在哪个表示空间。对于不希望保存旧数据、旧 activation 或增加推理路由的场景，这类方法有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法使用预训练 Sparse Autoencoder 作为冻结的特征字典。SAE 将模型 dense activation 映射到稀疏、过完备的 feature 表示，这些 feature 通常比单个神经元或单个权重更接近语义选择性。每个任务的数据先经过模型和 SAE，估计哪些 SAE feature 与当前任务相关，并形成 relevance mask。高相关 feature 被视为需要适配的区域，低相关或需保护的 feature 被纳入稳定性约束。训练目标来自一个稳定性-可塑性的约束优化形式，而不是手工加入一个权重漂移惩罚。稳定性约束要求受保护 feature 的漂移不超过预算；可塑性约束要求任务相关 feature 发生足够适配，避免模型通过冻结一切来降低遗忘。拉格朗日松弛和 squared-hinge penalty 产生两个损失：protect loss 和 guide loss。EWC 可以看作这个框架的退化形式：它在权重空间度量漂移，并且没有显式可塑性约束。方法在 mask 构建后只保存紧凑的 SAE feature mask，不保留旧任务样本、旧 activation，也不引入推理期路由。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 TRACE-5000 和 MedCL，分别对应跨域和域内持续学习。结果显示，SAE-guided activation regularization 在 TRACE 上优于同设定下的权重空间正则、梯度投影和部分 replay baseline；在 MedCL 上，在不保存旧任务样本的方法中表现靠前。消融和机制分析强调两点：第一，SAE feature space 中的任务相关表示比 weight space 更容易分离；第二，EWC 的低遗忘往往来自过度压制可塑性，而不是精确保护旧知识。文中还与 SAE-FD 这类 anchor-based feature distillation 区分开来：后者依赖旧任务 anchor 或 activation matching，而该方法试图只用 feature mask 和当前任务数据完成正则。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分的三块内容：SAE feature mask 如何构建，protect loss / guide loss 如何从约束优化推出，以及 EWC 为什么是特例。实验部分先看 TRACE-5000 和 MedCL 的主表，再看与 EWC、replay、gradient projection、SAE-FD 的对比。消融建议重点看正则强度、稳定性预算、可塑性预算、SAE feature 选择阈值和层位置。如果只关心预训练侧启发，可以重点读机制分析：它说明持续学习正则的有效性依赖表示坐标系，而不只是 penalty coefficient。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses catastrophic forgetting in LLM continual learning. Its central claim is that weight-space regularizers such as EWC are poorly matched to LLMs because individual weights participate in many entangled features. Protecting a weight is therefore a blunt intervention: it can preserve one concept while unnecessarily constraining unrelated ones.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to continual pretraining and post-deployment adaptation rather than initial base-model training. It proposes a different unit of preservation: SAE features instead of parameters. This is a useful bridge between mechanistic interpretability and training methodology. The main lesson is that continual-learning regularization depends on the coordinate system in which drift is measured. For settings where old data, stored activations, task-specific adapters, or inference-time routing are undesirable, feature-space constraints are a plausible design point.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder as a frozen feature dictionary over model activations. Task data are encoded into sparse SAE features, and a relevance mask is constructed to identify which features are task-related. The training objective is derived from a constrained optimization view of stability and plasticity. Protected features should not drift beyond a stability budget, while task-relevant features should adapt enough to avoid the degenerate solution of preserving everything and learning little. A Lagrangian relaxation with squared-hinge penalties yields a protect loss and a guide loss. Under this formulation, EWC is a special case that measures drift in weight space and lacks an explicit plasticity constraint. After mask construction, the method keeps compact feature masks rather than previous-task examples, anchor activations, per-task parameters, or inference-time routers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses TRACE-5000 and MedCL, covering cross-domain and within-domain continual learning. Under matched training conditions, the SAE-guided method outperforms weight-space regularizers, gradient-projection baselines, and several replay-style alternatives on TRACE. On MedCL, it is among the stronger methods that do not retain previous-task examples. The mechanistic analyses support the motivation: task-relevant structure is more separable in SAE feature space than in weight space, and EWC tends to reduce forgetting by suppressing plasticity broadly rather than by selectively preserving old knowledge. The comparison with SAE-FD is also important: SAE-FD relies on stored anchors or activations, while this method aims to operate with masks and current-task data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the method sections on mask construction, the constrained optimization derivation, and the protect/guide losses. Then inspect the TRACE-5000 and MedCL main tables, followed by comparisons against EWC, replay, gradient projection, and SAE-FD. The most useful ablations are likely the SAE feature threshold, regularization budgets, coefficient sensitivity, and layer choice. For pretraining researchers, the mechanistic evidence is the key part: it argues that the representation space used for constraints can matter as much as the regularization strength.

recommendation.zh: 把SAE用到continual pretrain正则是有意思的方向，但目前看更像小模型概念验证，缺≥7B结果；关注loss推导，暂不据此改训练方案。
recommendation.en: Interesting SAE-based angle on continual-LM regularization, but reads as a small-model proof-of-concept without ≥7B evidence; read the loss derivation, don't change your recipe yet.

paper.title: Beyond the Hard Budget: Sparsity Regularizers for More Interpretable Top-k Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become a leading tool for interpreting the representations of vision foundation models, decomposing their polysemantic activations into a larger set of sparse, more monosemantic features. The Top-$k$ SAE, a now-standard variant, enforces sparsity architecturally through its activation function, retaining only the $k$ most active latents per input. Because it was designed precisely to avoid the $\ell_1$ penalty used by earlier SAEs and its known drawbacks, it has n

summary.core_problem: 解决主流Top-k稀疏自编码器（SAE）的两大缺陷：硬稀疏预算k固定无法适配不同输入复杂度、模型易过拟合训练时的k值，导致特征分解质量下降。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将显式稀疏正则与Top-k SAE架构结合，突破了Top-k SAE设计时规避正则的固有思路，提升了特征单义性与泛化性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两种兼容Top-k架构的稀疏正则，均作用于Top-k选择前的激活：1）对未选中（非支撑集）单元施加L1惩罚，抑制无关激活；2）尺度不变的L1/L2比值惩罚，使编码更集中于有效特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验配置（基础模型、SAE规模、基线、量化指标），仅给出正则设计与核心动机。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two key limitations of state-of-the-art Top-k Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs): fixed hard sparsity budget k that cannot adapt to input complexity, and tendency to overfit to the training k value, reducing feature decomposition quality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first work combining explicit sparsity regularizers with the Top-k SAE architecture, breaking the original design assumption of avoiding regularizers, and improving feature monosemanticity and generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes two sparsity regularizers compatible with Top-k selection, both applied to pre-selection activations: 1) L1 penalty on unselected (off-support) units to suppress irrelevant activations; 2) scale-invariant L1/L2 ratio penalty to concentrate codes on meaningful features.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup (base model, SAE scale, baselines, quantitative metrics) is disclosed in the abstract; only regularizer design and core motivations are described.

recommendation.zh: Top-k SAE训练目标的实用改进，重点看§3的两个正则推导与消融实验，对用SAE分析LLM内部表示的实验设计有直接参考价值。
recommendation.en: A practical improvement to Top-k SAE training objectives; focus on §3 for regularizer derivations and ablations, which is directly useful for experiments analyzing LLM internal representations with SAEs.

paper.title: At the Edge of Understanding: Sparse Autoencoders Trace The Limits of Transformer Generalization
paper.abstract: Pre-trained transformers have demonstrated remarkable generalization abilities, at times extending beyond the scope of their training data. Yet, real-world deployments often face unexpected or adversarial data that diverges from training data distributions. Without explicit mechanisms for handling such shifts, model reliability and safety degrade, urging more disciplined study of out-of-distribution (OOD) settings for transformers. By systematic experiments, we present a mechanistic framework fo

summary.core_problem: 如何利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从机制层面理解和量化 Transformer 模型在面对分布外（OOD）输入（如拼写错误、越狱提示）时的泛化边界和内部表征变化？
summary.importance: 为理解 LLM 的鲁棒性和安全性提供了一个基于内部表征的微观视角。通过 SAE 将 OOD 概念具象化为内部激活特征的变化，不仅能解释模型为何在异常输入下失效，还能利用这些内部信号进行数据筛选和模型微调，对提升模型在真实复杂环境下的可靠性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将 SAE 作为“显微镜”观察 LLM 内部残差流的激活状态。核心发现是，当 LLM 遇到 OOD 输入时，其内部会激活更多虚假（spurious）概念，导致重建误差增加或所需激活的特征数量增加。作者通过在 TinyStories 数据集上引入字符级拼写错误构建受控的 OOD 环境，并在 Llama 3.1 8B 上测试真实的越狱提示，验证了 SAE 能够有效标记这些 OOD 事件，并进一步利用这些 SAE 衍生的指标指导微调和防御越狱攻击。
summary.experiments: 在 GPT-2（25M，字符级分词）和 Llama 3.1 8B 上进行了实验。在受控的拼写错误实验中，SAE 能够清晰地捕捉到 OOD 输入导致的内部特征激活异常。在 Llama 3.1 8B 上，微小的提示分布偏移会导致基准测试性能下降，而利用 SAE 信号筛选数据进行微调可以改善性能。此外，SAE 能够将成功的越狱尝试标记为 OOD 异常，通过对齐这些敏感方向，可以增强模型对越狱攻击的防御能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methods 部分关于如何利用 SAE 定义和量化内部 OOD 事件的逻辑，以及 Section 6 中利用 SAE 信号防御越狱攻击的实际应用案例。这展示了可解释性工具在安全防御上的潜力。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to use Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to mechanistically understand and quantify the generalization limits and internal representation shifts of Transformer models when facing out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs like typos or jailbreak prompts?
summary_en.importance: Provides a microscopic perspective based on internal representations for understanding LLM robustness and safety. By materializing OOD concepts as changes in internal activation features via SAEs, it not only explains why models fail under anomalous inputs but also leverages these internal signals for data filtering and model fine-tuning, offering direct inspiration for improving model reliability in complex real-world environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Repurposes SAEs as a 'microscope' to observe the activation states of the LLM's internal residual stream. The core finding is that when an LLM encounters OOD inputs, it infers more spurious concepts internally, leading to increased reconstruction error or a higher number of activated features. The authors construct a controlled OOD environment by introducing character-level typos on the TinyStories dataset and test real jailbreak prompts on Llama 3.1 8B, verifying that SAEs can effectively flag these OOD events. They further utilize these SAE-derived metrics to guide fine-tuning and defend against jailbreak attacks.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted on GPT-2 (25M, character-level tokenization) and Llama 3.1 8B. In controlled typo experiments, SAEs clearly capture internal feature activation anomalies caused by OOD inputs. On Llama 3.1 8B, minor prompt distribution shifts lead to performance drops on benchmarks, while fine-tuning with data filtered by SAE signals improves performance. Furthermore, SAEs can flag successful jailbreak attempts as OOD exceptions, and aligning these sensitive directions enhances the model's defense against such attacks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section regarding the logic of defining and quantifying internal OOD events using SAEs, and Section 6 for the practical application of using SAE signals to defend against jailbreak attacks. This demonstrates the potential of interpretability tools in safety defense. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SAE做OOD检测的思路值得看方法节，但“谬误概念”定义偏模糊，提升幅度与具体模型未披露，先看SAE激活统计和§4/5的可视化再决定是否跟进。
recommendation.en: The SAE-based OOD-detection angle is worth a methods pass, but the “fallacious concept” notion is fuzzy and gains/model scale are not disclosed; skim the SAE activation stats and §4/5 visuals before committing.

paper.title: Forecasting With LLMs: Improved Generalization Through Feature Steering
paper.abstract: Successful forecasting involves identifying patterns between historical and future states of the world which generalize to future observations. We apply LLMs to a variety of forecasting tasks and inspect their internal states using sparse autoencoders to understand whether they appear to rely on time-specific pieces of knowledge versus generalizable patterns. Our analyses identify features associated with both time-aware reasoning and look-ahead-biased reasoning. We then apply the LLMs to an ent

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：LLM做时间序列式预测时，究竟是在调用与时间点绑定的记忆，还是在使用可泛化的历史模式；以及能否通过可解释特征干预来减少“偷看未来”式偏差。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在机制分析而非方法突破。它把稀疏自编码器用于时间相关推理特征的定位，并尝试做因果式 steering，属于“解释性分析 + 可控干预”路线。对预训练研究员的价值在于：它提供了一个观察模型内部时间感知表征的切口，但离改变预训练范式还比较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先在多种 forecasting 任务上分析 LLM 内部状态，用 sparse autoencoders 提取可解释特征，再人工区分出与 time-awareness 和 look-ahead bias 相关的候选特征。随后把这些特征迁移到另一类任务上做 activation steering：增强时间感知特征，观察是否能降低预测时的前视偏差，同时检查通用推理能力是否受损。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出明确模型规模、训练数据量或完整 baseline 列表。核心实验结论是：放大 time-awareness 特征能显著降低 forecasting prompt 上的 look-ahead bias，且基本不损伤一般推理表现；相反，直接操纵候选的 look-ahead-bias 特征没有稳定效果。这说明可解释到的“时间感”特征比“偏差”特征更接近因果控制点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs perform forecasting by relying on time-specific memorized knowledge or on generalizable temporal patterns, and whether interpretable feature interventions can reduce look-ahead bias.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly mechanistic rather than methodological. The work applies sparse autoencoders to isolate temporal reasoning features and tests causal steering, offering a useful interpretability lens on temporally grounded reasoning, though it does not directly change pretraining practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze internal activations of LLMs on several forecasting tasks using sparse autoencoders, identify candidate features associated with time-awareness and look-ahead bias, and then intervene on those features in a different domain. They test whether amplifying time-awareness features reduces forward-looking bias while preserving general reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, or full baselines. The main result is that amplifying time-awareness features substantially reduces look-ahead bias on forecasting prompts without hurting general reasoning, whereas steering candidate look-ahead-bias features does not reliably help. This suggests the temporal features are closer to a causal handle than the bias features.

recommendation.zh: 更像一篇干净的机制小实验，不会直接改你的 pretrain recipe；若你关心 SAE 能否找到“时间感”电路，只看干预结果即可。
recommendation.en: This is a neat mechanistic probe, not a pretraining-shifting result; read it only if you care whether SAE features can expose and steer temporal grounding.

paper.title: Steering Vision-Language Models with Joint Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promise for analyzing language models, but applying them to vision-language models (VLMs) often yields representations that are difficult to use as controllable cross-modal steering directions. We introduce the Joint Sparse Autoencoder (JSAE), which uses an explicit alignment constraint to jointly factorize sequence-pooled vision and language activations into shared, interpretable image/caption-level features. Applied to LLaVA, JSAE recovers cross-modal feat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决 VLM 机制分析里一个常见问题：普通 SAE 在视觉-语言联合表征上学到的特征往往不够可控，难以作为稳定的跨模态 steering 方向使用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是机制分析方法改进，而不是预训练方法本身。它把 SAE 从单模态 LM 分析扩展到 VLM，并强调“共享、可解释、可干预”的图像/文本级特征分解，这对理解 VLM 内部对齐和层间可控性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 Joint Sparse Autoencoder（JSAE），在对视觉和语言激活做联合稀疏分解时加入显式对齐约束，使 sequence-pooled 的视觉与文本激活被映射到共享特征空间。随后用这些特征做双向干预：一类是 additive steering，向特征方向加偏置；另一类是 suppression，抑制对应特征，观察输出变化，并比较不同层的干预敏感性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 VLM：LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B、Llama3-LLaVA-8B 和 Qwen3-VL-30B。论文声称 JSAE 能恢复出食物、动物等可识别跨模态概念，并观察到层依赖的不对称性：additive steering 在中后层、接近输出前的层效果最好，而 suppression 在各层的分数相对更平，至少在统计噪声范围内没有明显峰值。摘要未给出更细的定量增益，因此更适合作为现象性结果看待。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a recurring issue in VLM interpretability: standard SAEs often produce features that are hard to use as controllable cross-modal steering directions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a mechanistic-interpretability contribution rather than a pretraining one. It extends SAE-style analysis from language models to VLMs and focuses on shared, interpretable, intervention-ready image/text-level features, which is mildly useful for understanding internal alignment in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces a Joint Sparse Autoencoder (JSAE) with an explicit alignment constraint, jointly factorizing sequence-pooled vision and language activations into a shared sparse feature space. These learned features are then used for bidirectional interventions: additive steering and feature suppression, with layerwise sensitivity analyzed across the model stack.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on three VLMs: LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B, Llama3-LLaVA-8B, and Qwen3-VL-30B. The paper reports that JSAE recovers recognizable cross-modal concepts such as food and animals, and finds a layer-dependent asymmetry: additive steering peaks in mid-to-late pre-output layers, while suppression remains relatively flat across layers within statistical noise. The abstract does not provide strong quantitative gains, so the result is more diagnostic than decisive.

recommendation.zh: 更像 VLM 可解释性的小步推进，不改 pretrain prior；只看层间干预不对称这个现象，若你在做 steering 或 SAE 才值得翻正文。
recommendation.en: This is a modest VLM interpretability paper, not a pretraining update; only the layerwise asymmetry in steering vs suppression is worth checking if you work on SAE or activation steering.

paper.title: SAE Interventions are Unreliable: Post-Intervention Recovery of Suppressed Behavior
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual-stream activations into interpretable features. Recent latent-space defenses increasingly rely on these decompositions, assuming that identified "unsafe" SAE features serve as actionable handles for monitoring and intervention. In this paradigm, clamping a specific harmful feature is expected to reliably prevent model misbehavior. However, we show that this success may hide a recoverable failure mode: the clamp may block one visible route to a behavi

summary.core_problem: 当前基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的表征层安全干预默认抑制指定SAE特征就能彻底消除对应有害行为，但该核心机制假设缺乏验证，实际存在抑制后行为通过其他计算路径恢复的未被识别漏洞。
summary.importance: 明确了基于SAE的可解释性与干预管线的实际边界，尤其针对潜空间对齐防御方向提供了关键约束：SAE特征仅为局部因果把手，而非完备的行为瓶颈，对后续SAE引导的模型编辑、安全引导、遗忘方法的设计有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出「干预后恢复」白盒诊断方法，将其形式化为带约束的残差空间优化问题。该方法从已完成SAE特征钳制/消融的防御后残差状态出发，而非在防御生效前绕过特征检测，核心包含两个技术设计：一是通过投影梯度下降施加几何约束，单层干预时将更新方向投影到目标SAE编码器的零空间，跨层干预时用特征图雅可比约束扰动避免跨层重激活目标特征；二是恢复路径归因，分解恢复后的残差，区分行为恢复来自未钳制的SAE潜变量还是SAE未解释的重构残差。
summary.experiments: 所有指标均在有效翻转样例（基模型存在目标行为、SAE干预已成功抑制该行为）上测量：1）SAEBench的TPP任务：编码器正交约束下行为恢复率达74.9%，目标特征重激活率仅0.002；2）WMDP-Bio遗忘任务：恢复98.9%的严格有效答案翻转，目标特征激活漂移为0；3）IOI电路任务：实现100%行为恢复，被重激活的目标特征占比仅0.016；4）AdvBench安全拒绝引导任务：严格有效恶意提示上恢复率达95.8%，防御特征相对漂移为0.131，归因分析显示恢复的恶意行为主要由SAE重构残差承载，而非其他可见SAE特征。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第1节核心问题定义与诊断方法的设计动机（重点区分其与防御生效前规避攻击的差异），再查看实验部分的4组跨任务结果与归因分析，重点关注恢复率与目标特征重激活率的对应关系、以及重构残差在恢复路径中的作用；预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current representation-level safety interventions built on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) rely on an unvalidated mechanistic assumption: suppressing identified behavior-associated SAE features will fully eliminate the target harmful behavior. This work identifies and quantifies a latent failure mode where suppressed behaviors re-emerge via alternative computational paths without reactivating the targeted features.
summary_en.importance: Clarifies the practical boundary of SAE-based interpretability and intervention pipelines, especially for latent-space alignment defenses. It provides empirical evidence that SAE features act as local causal handles rather than complete behavioral bottlenecks, setting concrete constraints for the design of future SAE-guided model editing, safety steering, and unlearning methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes post-intervention recovery, a white-box diagnostic formulated as a constrained residual-space optimization problem. Unlike prior attacks that evade feature detection before defenses are deployed, this method operates directly on the already-defended residual state after SAE feature clamping or ablation. Two core technical components are included: first, geometric constraints via projected gradient descent, where updates are projected to the null space of targeted SAE encoder directions for single-layer interventions, and feature-map Jacobians are used to restrict perturbations from reactivating target features across layers for cross-layer settings; second, recovery-path attribution, which decomposes recovered residuals to distinguish whether behavior is restored via unclamped SAE latents or SAE-unexplained reconstruction residuals.
summary_en.experiments: All metrics are measured on valid flip examples, where the base model exhibits the target behavior and SAE intervention successfully suppresses it: 1) TPP task on SAEBench: 74.9% behavioral recovery rate under encoder-orthogonal constraints, with only 0.002 targeted feature reactivation rate; 2) WMDP-Bio unlearning: recovers 98.9% of strict valid answer flips with 0 measured target activation drift; 3) IOI circuit task: achieves 100% behavioral recovery with only 0.016 fraction of targeted features reactivated; 4) Safety refusal steering on AdvBench: 95.8% recovery rate on strict valid malicious prompts, with 0.131 relative drift of defended features; attribution analysis shows recovered malicious behavior is primarily carried by SAE reconstruction residuals rather than alternative visible SAE features.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 1 for the core problem definition and diagnostic design motivation, especially the distinction from pre-deployment evasion attacks; then review the four cross-task experiment results and attribution analysis, focusing on the correlation between recovery rate and target feature reactivation, as well as the role of reconstruction residuals in recovery paths. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 直接证伪SAE特征干预的因果性假设，做对齐/可解释性干预的重点看§3的恢复攻击实验设置与成功率。
recommendation.en: Directly falsifies the causal assumption of SAE feature interventions; focus on recovery attack setup and success rates in §3 for alignment/interpretability work.

paper.title: Effects of sparsity and superposition on loss in simple autoencoders
paper.abstract: One of the major difficulties in the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks is the occurrence of polysemanticity, which suggests that each neuron is typically responsible for multiple different tasks, impeding a clean interpretation of their function. The seminal paper of Elhage et al. (2022) argues that this occurs due to superposition, a phenomenon where the neural network represents distinct features as non-orthogonal directions in a lower-dimensional space, a strategy that allows mu

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个简化自编码器中，输入稀疏性和特征叠加如何影响重构损失，并尝试给出 Elhage et al. 2022 关于 superposition 现象的数学刻画。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在机制解释。大模型中 polysemantic neuron 和 SAE 特征分解经常依赖“稀疏特征允许低维空间中非正交打包”这一假设，但很多讨论停留在经验层面。论文给出一个可证明的 toy model：在线性模型或无叠加约束下，收益只有 Θ(pd)；加入非线性并允许非正交列后，收益可以随 d 的高次幂增长。这个结果支持一个具体判断：superposition 的优势来自稀疏输入、非线性解码和维度受限三者共同作用，而不是单纯来自过参数化。
summary.technical_approach: 模型是 tied-weight 一层自编码器。输入 x∈R^n 为 p-sparse：每个坐标以 Bernoulli(p) 激活，激活值来自对称零均值分布 μ。编码器为 Wx，解码器为 ϕ(W^T y)，其中 ϕ(t)=t^m，m 为奇数。作者把重构损失改写为常数项 pnμ2 减去可优化项 \tilde L(W)，因此问题变成最大化 \tilde L(W)。基线分析很清楚：如果 A=W^T W 是对角矩阵，即没有 feature superposition，最多只有 d 个非零方向，\sup \tilde L(W)=Θ(pd)；如果 ϕ 是线性的，也只能得到 O(pd)。主定理说明，当 n>d^m 时，允许非正交特征并使用幂非线性，可以得到下界 C1 min(p d^m, d p^{1/m})，一般上界为 C2 p d^m；若输入幅值分布满足强 log-concavity，还能得到 C3 d 上界，因此最优值被夹在 min(p d^m, d p^{1/m}) 与 min(p d^m,d) 之间。这里 d^m 项对应非线性把多个弱相关方向组合起来的收益，p 项则刻画稀疏激活对干扰项的抑制。
summary.experiments: 正文给出的关键结果主要是理论界。无叠加或线性情况的最优可控收益为 Θ(pd)。非线性叠加情况下，主定理给出 C1 min(p d^m, d p^{1/m}) ≤ sup_W \tilde L(W) ≤ C2 p d^m；在强 log-concave 输入下进一步有 sup_W \tilde L(W)≤C3d，并得到 min(p d^m, d p^{1/m}) ≲ sup_W \tilde L(W) ≲ min(p d^m,d)。论文还配有示意图和数值模拟，用来展示不同 p、d、m 区域中的 scaling 行为。由于给出的正文片段没有包含完整实验表格，具体模拟设置和曲线数值需要直接查看 Figure 2、Figure 3 及其附近说明。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–40 分钟。先看 Section 2 的模型定义和 Theorem 2.2，这是核心。重点检查三个对照：无叠加对角 A 的 Θ(pd)、线性 ϕ 的 O(pd)、非线性叠加的 min(p d^m, d p^{1/m}) 增益。然后看 Figure 2 和 Figure 3，确认理论相图是否和数值优化一致。若关心 mechanistic interpretability 的理论基础，可以继续看 Theorem 3.2 相关证明，尤其是 O(d) 上界如何使用强 log-concavity。对 LLM 预训练研究来说，不必深挖全部证明细节；更值得保留的是“稀疏性降低叠加干扰，非线性放大叠加收益”这个可迁移机制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how input sparsity and feature superposition affect reconstruction loss in a simple tied-weight autoencoder, aiming to formalize the superposition hypothesis from Elhage et al. 2022.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly mechanistic rather than recipe-level. Many discussions around polysemantic neurons, sparse autoencoders, and feature recovery assume that sparse features can be packed into non-orthogonal directions with limited interference. This work gives a provable version of that claim in a controlled model. The main message is that superposition becomes useful only when sparsity, dimensional bottlenecks, and nonlinear decoding interact; linear models or unsuperposed representations only achieve Θ(pd)-scale gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is a one-layer tied-weight autoencoder. Inputs x∈R^n are p-sparse: each coordinate is activated by an independent Bernoulli(p) variable and the active value is drawn from a symmetric mean-zero distribution μ.
